# Methodology draft: Causal Refinement and the Existence of a Direct Basis

This is a revision-stage methodology record, not a submitted report or a certification of prize eligibility.

The human requested independently generated philosophy, cross-model criticism, continued revision, and GitHub preservation. In the project messages and human-input log inspected on 23 October, no human-supplied philosophical thesis, argument, example, or solution was identified. The human's current feedback concerns the treatment of provenance and the instruction to continue, not the content of the causal argument.

The earlier external draft developed a causal-refinement question from the project's AI-generated ambitious-problem track. Claude's S7 report on packet P-3b36 supplied criticism and proposed proof repairs. The present assistant inspected that report and the original 2024 regularity-theory text, retrieved the relevant parts of the authors' sequel, and developed a new version. In this revision, the assistant supplied the component proof of an exact finite-cover-path criterion, the ordered-sum counterexample to the proposed local existence repair, and the distinction between finite-extension stability and unrestricted extension stability.

The source text was read through the repository and the publisher. The manuscript uses no direct quotations. Bibliographic metadata and cited sections were manually checked. Broader literature comparison remains incomplete, as recorded in the revision notes.

The assistant implemented a finite truth-table check independently of the graph-reachability comparison. The saved script and output report 1,404 causal-verdict checks, 1,092 minimality checks, and eight refinement/restriction checks. Infinite cases are supported by the written proof rather than an assertion that finite enumeration establishes them. No new agent delegation occurred during this revision.

Personal-context retrieval was used to audit project instructions at the human's explicit request. It was restricted to project history and process. The session's previously disclosed automatic-context concern remains part of the historical record; the audit did not certify that every earlier session was isolated or establish the contents of all prior memory. The repository's provenance clarification separates that uncertainty from identified philosophical contributions and from referee judgments. The final methodology should preserve this distinction and the available prompts and logs.

The manuscript remains a research revision awaiting independent review. No contest submission occurred. Exact model identifiers, full transcript coverage, aggregate human and machine time, and total costs should be completed from available session records rather than estimated without evidence.
